thread:
Maya (Docs): Noticed an example in PR #4920 that includes `project_id` in both the URL and the request body. That contradicts our guidance. Can we standardize?
Liam (SDK): Strong agree. Examples and SDK snippets should use path params only. We can add a migration note for legacy clients that put id in body.
Rina (API): FYI runtime currently treats the path value as authoritative and quietly ignores a body `project_id`. We should either document that behavior or change the server to error on mismatches.
Maya (Docs): Let's document the current behavior first (less disruptive). Add a short migration callout: "Move ids to path; server currently ignores body id; future releases may enforce mismatch errors."
Sam (Platform): I'll log an infra ticket so tests cover this explicitly: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/912
Liam (SDK): Example suggestion for docs:
```
# avoid this
POST /v1/projects/abcd/items
{ "project_id": "abcd", "name": "widget" }

# recommended
POST /v1/projects/abcd/items
{ "name": "widget" }
```
And show SDK call like: client.CreateItem(ctx, "abcd", CreateItemRequest{Name: "widget"})
Maya (Docs): I'll update the OpenAPI example file and the curl/py/go snippets. DocCI flagged examples/openapi/project-items.yaml with a lint E302 earlier.
DocCI Bot: docs/pr-4920: lint error E302 3 - duplicate path param in example payload.
Maya (Docs): Fixed the example and pushed. Added one-line description to the `project_id` path param: "Authoritative identifier for the request; if duplicated in body it will be ignored."
Rina (API): Good. That description helps codegenerators and SDK teams.
Liam (SDK): Tiny nit: in Go snippets prefer using a passed `ctx` variable rather than `context.Background()`. I'll comment on the PR.
Maya (Docs): Added migration checklist bullets and cross-linked top-level API ref. Pushed changes to PR #4920 and requested reviews from @Rina and @Liam.
DocCI Bot: docs/pr-4920: CI passed after example fix. :white_check_mark:
Sam (Platform): After approvals I'll queue the infra regression test. For now doc-first approach agreed.
Maya (Docs): Thanks all — merging once reviewers approve.
